description: This file contains a forked implementation of Go's reflect.DeepEqual functionality, including custom equality functions, deep comparison logic, and handling of unexported types, used for semantic equality checks in Go programs.

classes.name: visit
classes.description: A struct used to keep track of visited comparisons during deep equality checks, identified by memory addresses and type.

classes.name: unexportedTypePanic
classes.description: A custom type representing a panic when encountering unexported types during reflection-based comparison.

methods.name: EqualitiesOrDie
methods.description: Creates an Equalities map from provided functions, panics on error.

methods.name: AddFuncs
methods.description: Adds multiple equality functions to the Equalities map.

methods.name: AddFunc
methods.description: Adds a single equality function, validating its signature.

methods.name: DeepEqual
methods.description: Performs a semantic deep equality check between two interfaces, using custom functions if available.

methods.name: DeepEqualWithNilDifferentFromEmpty
methods.description: Performs deep equality, treating nil and empty slices/maps as different.

methods.name: deepValueEqual
methods.description: Internal recursive function that compares reflect.Values for deep equality, considering custom functions and handling various kinds.

methods.name: deepValueDerive
methods.description: Internal recursive function for deep comparison, ignoring unset fields in the first argument.
